mask_background_tensor: mask the background of an RGB image tensor using a foreground segmentation mask and a specified background color
mask_background_white: mask the background of an RGB image tensor with white using a binary foreground mask
mask_background_black: mask the background of an RGB image tensor with black using a binary foreground mask
mask_background_float: mask the background of an RGB image tensor with a uniform float color value using a foreground mask
mask_background_rgb_tuple: mask the background of an RGB image tensor with an RGB tuple color using a foreground mask
